name: GPI Packaging Catalog
brief: Business Central foundation for Gamer Packaging product catalog, commercial pricing logic, and reusable commercial AI-agent orchestration
description: Isolated Business Central extension for packaging products, vendor locations, supplier cost history, freight rates, deterministic landed-cost calculations, gross-margin guidance, customer pricing guardrails, saved packaging quote workflows, approval decisions, durable quote audit history, customer-specific historical pricing review, deterministic sourcing comparisons, route-mileage freight fallback, BC Item catalog discovery, controlled sandbox catalog pilot seeding, a demo-oriented packaging product discovery workspace, direct product or landed-cost-to-quote workflow actions, compact commercial quote review, quote-level commercial totals, actionable commercial review status, UOM-aware quote quantity, cost, and proposed-sell normalization, immediate parent quote commercial-review refresh after quote-line edits, query-backed posted-sales history evaluation for responsive guardrail checks, explicit guardrail action feedback, draft-only guardrail evaluation actions, read-only posted Value Entry cost evidence, an in-client historical posted landed-cost evidence view, multi-file packaging product document storage, approved customer-facing packaging quote preview and PDF output, customer-facing specification de-duplication, prepared customer quote email with the approved PDF attached for user review before sending, a BC-side Spiro integration foundation with persistent customer mapping and quote CRM context, a controlled Business Central opportunity-selection workflow backed by externally refreshed Spiro opportunity cache data, and a reusable commercial-agent platform with deterministic candidate screening, controlled AI evaluation contracts, durable exception/evidence persistence, a retryable evaluation queue, sandbox-only disabled-by-default trigger subscribers, sandbox-hardened agent setup API control, a hardened item-number validation trigger for Incorrect Item queueing, server-ordered historical sales context compatible with Business Central API Query limitations, correlation, confidence, review, and feedback records for Low Margin, Cost Change, Incorrect Item, and future commercial AI agents. Spiro credentials and outbound Spiro API calls remain outside AL. Internal landed-cost, margin, guardrail, history, approval, agent evidence, and audit fields remain excluded from customer output. This extension is separate from the Zetadocs replacement extension.
